decisions.reason: Because it remained prominently featured on the home page in both 2023 and 2024 and fits the firm's advisory and partnership-building capabilities, its visible traction appears at least close enough to aspiration levels to justify continued support given the firm's growth and slack.

The firm kept a dedicated page for this product across both years, suggesting results have not fallen clearly below aspirations and that a growing, R&D-oriented machinery firm would continue exploring a strategically related low-carbon materials application.
